title: Reletting Months Remaining on a Lease Term Agreement — Training Questions
content:
**Rule.** For the reletting fee of a lease break on a Lease Term Agreement, the reletting months remaining are counted by the notice the request gave, the calendar days from the date the request was received to the requested termination date: under 30 days, the full months from the received date to the term end date; 30 to 59 days, the full months from the termination date to the term end date plus one for the month in progress; 60 days or more, the full months from the termination date to the term end date.

**Q. Which dates are read?** The date the open lease-break request was submitted (the received date) and the termination date asked for on it, together with the term end date of the Lease Term Agreement.

**Q. How are the notice days counted?** As the number of calendar days by which the received date precedes the requested termination date.

**Q. How are full months counted?** In whole calendar months; a month is complete when the same day number of a later month is reached.

| Notice the request gave | Reletting months remaining |
|---|---|
| under 30 days | full months from the received date to the term end date |
| 30 to 59 days | full months from the termination date to the term end date, plus one |
| 60 days or more | full months from the termination date to the term end date |

**Q. Worked cases? (hypothetical term end date 14 December)**

| Received | Termination date | Notice given | Reletting months remaining |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 June | 20 June | 19 days | from 1 June to 14 December: 6 |
| 1 June | 20 July | 49 days | from 20 July to 14 December: 4, plus one: 5 |
| 1 June | 20 August | 80 days | from 20 August to 14 December: 3 |
| 1 June | 31 July | 60 days | from 31 July to 14 December: 4 |
